name: L.D.C. S.A.
summary: L.D.C. S.A. produces and sells poultry and convenience products in France and internationally. The company offers cooked meals, pizzas, sandwiches, pancakes and crepes, ethnic food, rolled pastry, quiches, cakes and pies. It is also involved in feed manufacturing; poultry farming; egg production; abattoirs; poultry-based foodstuff processing and marketing business. It offers its products under the Le Gaulois, Maître CoQ, Loué, Marie, Poule & Toque, Nature & Respect, Drosed, Goldenfood, and Doux brand names. L.D.C. S.A. was founded in 1909 and is based in Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France.
